title.zh: 磁场与洛伦兹力 · 力总是垂直于速度
title.en: Magnetic Force · The Force Is Always Sideways to the Velocity

desc.zh: 从一个带电粒子在磁场里“拐弯”出发，推出圆半径、周期，再用它称离子质量、挑选速度。
desc.en: Start with a charged particle bending in a magnetic field, derive its radius and period, then use them to weigh ions and pick out a speed.
